sources.entry: Kibitzr - Lightweight personal web assistant with powerful integrations. (Source Code) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: Kibitzr is a lightweight personal web assistant that runs routine web-monitoring and automation tasks for you, per the awesome-selfhosted listing.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly badges and links, so it gives few concrete details. It describes Kibitzr as a personal assistant that performs routine tasks without needing input. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a lightweight personal web assistant with powerful integrations, listed under Automation. The README links to documentation, an issue tracker, and a Gitter chat for help. Specific features are not described in the README text provided.
notable: Documentation hosted separately (link not included in README text)
caveats: README is nearly empty; installation and feature details are not given in it
Integrations are mentioned only in the awesome-selfhosted listing, not in the README
